entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
entry.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate
entry.renewal: Retired; existing holders active 3 years from date earned

reading.cost: 300 USD. Additional cost information including foreign exchange rates is available on the Exam pricing page.
reading.format: 65 questions, either multiple choice or multiple response. Delivered at Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam. Languages offered: English, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.
reading.status: This certification is being retired. The last day to take this exam is March 31, 2026. Certification holders will still have an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned.
reading.summary: This certification validates expertise in building and deploying machine learning solutions on AWS. It demonstrates ability to architect ML/deep learning workloads, optimize model training, and implement production-ready ML systems following AWS best practices. Holding it shows skills in building, training, tuning, and deploying ML models on AWS.
reading.audience: Intended for individuals in AI and ML development or data science roles. Ideal candidates have two or more years of experience developing, architecting, and running ML or deep learning workloads in the AWS Cloud.
reading.validity: Valid for 3 years. Recertify by passing the latest version of this exam before expiration. Certification holders will still have an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned.
reading.prerequisites: No specific certifications are required. Candidates commonly earn AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, and/or AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate beforehand. Earning an AWS Associate or Professional certification first is beneficial.
